subject: Final custody & clearance: prompt artifact purge for HealthScript
messages:
From: Elaine Perez <elaine.perez@healthscript.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: HealthScript Legal <legal@healthscript.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Full purge of prompts/outputs for tenant HS-9931 / confirmation timeline

Hi Marissa,

Per our retention policy review, HealthScript needs Redwood to execute a full purge of all prompt/assistant outputs, session logs, and derived embeddings for tenant HS-9931 (production and sandbox) going back to ingestion start (2023-09-01). We understand the retention windows in contract may differ, but Legal has escalated this as a data minimization request that must be completed and evidenced by next week.

Can you confirm:
- Which artifacts will be deleted (prompt inputs, generation outputs, KV cache, embedding vectors, audit logs vs metadata)
- Whether you will provide a signed receipt and chain-of-custody for the purge job
- Estimated completion window and any customer-facing downtime or API keys that need rotation

I've attached HealthScript's signed erasure request (healthscript_erasure_request.pdf). Please let me know if you need a PO or additional forms.

Thanks,
Elaine Perez
Head of Data Privacy
HealthScript Inc.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Perez <elaine.perez@healthscript.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Full purge of prompts/outputs for tenant HS-9931 / confirmation timeline

Hi Elaine,

Thanks for the request and the signed form — got it. Bringing Ops and Security into the loop to confirm scope and produce an evidence bundle. Quick answers up-front:
- Scope: we will remove prompt inputs, model generation outputs, derived embeddings, and per-request KV cache snapshots tied to HS-9931.
- We do not delete immutable infra-level audit records required for compliance (e.g., system-level ingestion timestamps) but we will produce redacted audit manifests that prove execution.
- Deliverables: signed purge receipt, proof bundle (manifest + hashes + job logs), and a short evidence summary suitable for Legal.
- Estimated timeline: Ops can start the purge on Monday 2026-04-05 and complete by EOD 2026-04-06, barring any unexpected throttling.

Ben / Sean — please confirm ops ticket and whether we need HealthScript to rotate any keys during the run.

I will follow up with the formal manifest and DocuSign-ready clearance once Ops confirms.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: healthscript_erasure_request.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Elaine Perez <elaine.perez@healthscript.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Full purge of prompts/outputs for tenant HS-9931 / confirmation timeline

Marissa / Elaine — I created OPS-4521 to track the work and scheduled a dry-run on our dev cluster today to validate the purge tooling against a synthetic HS-9931 snapshot. Notes from dry-run: 
- Purge components: prompt inputs (S3 prefix s3://redwood/prompt-logs/hs-9931/), generation outputs (s3://redwood/outputs/hs-9931/), embeddings (vectorstore namespace hs-9931), and KV cache snapshots (kv-cache/hs-9931/).
- Audit artifacts: we emit a manifest.json with deleted object keys + SHA256 hashes and a job log (purge-job-OPS-4521.log). These are stored in a customer-only evidence bucket for 30 days before being copied into the signed receipt bundle.
- No customer API downtime required; however, we recommend rotating any API keys that are embedded in model prompts as a precaution. We can coordinate a short maintenance window if HealthScript prefers.
- Estimated run-time on prod: 3-6 hours depending on data volume; we'll disable batching to ensure completeness (slower but deterministic).

Next steps: I will schedule the production run for Mon 2026-04-05 01:00 UTC. We will produce the evidence zip and share a DocuSign receipt link.

Ben Carter
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: purge-dryrun-notes.txt (summary)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Perez <elaine.perez@healthscript.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Purge completed: HS-9931 evidence bundle and signed receipt link

Hi Elaine —

Purge job OPS-4521 completed at 2026-04-05T15:47:22Z. Deliverables attached and linked below:
- redwood_erasure_receipt.json (machine-readable manifest: deleted_keys (list), sha256_hashes, job_id, start_time, end_time)
- purge-evidence-bundle-HS-9931.zip (contains manifest.json, purge-job-OPS-4521.log, deleted-object-summaries.txt)
- DocuSign link for a final clearance signature (https://www.docusign.com/recipient?env=na1&id=ABCD1234)

Summary highlights:
- Objects removed: 12,437 keys across prompt logs, outputs, and embeddings.
- KV cache snapshots removed: 128 snapshots.
- We retained system-level ingestion audit pointers; sensitive lines in those logs were redacted (redaction manifest included).

Attached: redwood_erasure_receipt.json (stub). Please review and sign the DocuSign clearance so we can close the ticket and move the evidence into the long-term legal vault. If you need an on-record notarized confirmation, let me know and we'll escalate to Legal Ops.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Ops Engineer, Data Integrity | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_erasure_receipt.json, purge-evidence-bundle-HS-9931.zip
From: Elaine Perez <elaine.perez@healthscript.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: HealthScript Legal <legal@healthscript.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2026 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purge completed: HS-9931 evidence bundle and signed receipt link

Sean / Marissa —

Thank you — we received the bundle and verified the manifest against our internal record sample. HealthScript Legal has signed the DocuSign clearance; attached is the signed_clearance_healthscript.pdf. This closes the erasure request from our side.

A couple internal asks for audit: could you add the OPS ticket number and the job's SHA256 root hash into the signed receipt JSON (redwood_erasure_receipt.json) and re-issue the final file into the legal vault? Also please confirm retention of the evidence bundle on Redwood's customer-only bucket for the stated 30 days prior to vaulting.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Elaine Perez
Head of Data Privacy
HealthScript Inc.

Attachment: signed_clearance_healthscript.pdf
